rv.q: If you think that “wiping away tears of laughter and sorrow” is one those activities that, like “rolling in the aisles”, only happens in reviews, you give should this show a visit.
This joyous, cathartic musical looks set to see out many calendars.
With all the arguments and upheaval currently in the world, The Girls is a heart warming tonic.
Yet The Girls also blossoms into a feel-good hit as bright as a field of sunflowers.

cn.t: This musical adaptation of Calendar Girls earns praise for its fresh, joyous approach and moving emotional depth, with Barlow and Firth delivering a winning reinvention rather than a tired rehash of the familiar story.
